brief: Holds the four universal rules an organisation chart must keep, as the set an org chart judges itself with.
detail: The set carries no-self-report and no-cyclic-reporting as errors, and no-orphan-position and span-of-control as warnings, in the org-governance set of the orgchart domain. The compliance bases in stzOrgChart carry the same universal tier. Use the set directly to add a rule of your own before checking a graph.
